source: Year element/animal, mewa and parkha cycles per published Tibetan almanac tables (year tables 1955-2039 cross-checked between two independent compilations; mewa 1900-2099 tables). Five-force rules per the Tibetan Elemental Astrology (nag rtsis) textual tradition.

method.srog: The animal's fixed element (unanimous across all published tables checked).
method.lus: The year's element, per the natal year-table in the 'Tibetan Astrology' compilation (year tables 2005-2024: the Health column equals the year's element in all 20 rows). Lineage variation exists: some almanacs (e.g., a published 2024 Tibetan horoscope book) tabulate lus differently, e.g. Body=Metal for natal Wood Ox.
method.dbang_thang: The year's element, per the explicit rule in the Elemental Astrology text ('the power element is the same as the element that rules the year'), confirmed by a second published year-table. Lineage variation exists.
method.rlung_ta: Fixed animal table, confirmed by four independent sources (year tables + the mnemonic verses: Tiger/Horse/Dog -> Iron; Mouse/Dragon/Monkey -> Wood; Bird/Ox/Snake -> Water; Pig/Sheep/Hare -> Fire).
method.bla: The mother element of srog, per the proverb 'Srog gi rna ni bla ru grags' (the ear of srog is known as bla); verified 12/12 against published tables.
method.year_boundary: Tibetan Losar. Computed here from Chinese New Year via lunardate as an approximation: Losar usually coincides with CNY but occasionally differs by days or weeks (e.g., 2022, 2023). Boundary-period results are flagged.
method.disclaimer: Tibetan lineages (monastic almanacs) vary in details; this follows the nag rtsis elemental tradition. Interpretive; not computed fact.
